verdict.rationale: CrewAI's CLI supports creating a crew/agent from a template (`crewai create`), running it headlessly (`crewai run`), and verifying execution via `crewai test`, which reports performance metrics after N iterations — all invocable from a terminal without a UI. However, the docs don't describe pre-built 'example agents' shipped with the framework specifically for self-verification, nor a documented pattern where an agent verifies its own just-built output; this is an implication built from generic CLI docs rather than a dedicated example/verification workflow. Missing for 10: bundled example-agent projects, explicit self-verification-loop documentation, and independent hands-on confirmation of headless test runs.
